LanguageData.RT_T34_Vehicle.label: T-34-76
LanguageData.RT_T34_Vehicle.description:
Famous Soviet medium tank with sloped armor and 76.2mm F-34 gun. Upgradable with 57mm ZIS-2, 122mm howitzer, or OT-34 flamethrower.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander/Gunner x1, Loader x1, Bow Gunner x1 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 76.2mm F-34 Cannon: 76.2x385mmR (APHE / HE / Shrapnel) - 7.62mm DT MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP) - (Upgrade 57mm ZIS-2): 57x480mmR (APHE / HE) - (Upgrade 122mm Howitzer): 122mmHowitzer Cannon shell (HE / APHE) - (Upgrade OT-34 Flamethrower): Prometheum canister
